top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a mature, replicated physiology-to-medicine chain: Holst on the incretin effect and GLP-1 secretion and action in humans, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide biology and receptor pharmacology, and Mojsov on identifying the active GLP-1(7-36) form. Independent outcome trials have since shown metabolic, cardiovascular and renal benefit. The three-name allocation and the citation, which credits the physiology and the active peptide and not particular drugs, keep the scope defensible. An award is clearly preferable to no award.
